verdict.rationale: ReadMe's first-party docs say developers can explore the API, make test calls from the documentation and see real responses without writing code. They also describe turning an OpenAPI file into interactive documentation and injecting users' API keys and server variables into the reference. A community comment says ReadMe has strong Swagger support, but it does not speak to the try-it experience directly. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the try-it calls work, and clear evidence of multi-language runnable code samples (only a thin 'Pick a language' mention).
